title: LAVE stall termination: admit-probe rejection runs and GenerationExhausted rate
claim_class: fixture-demo telemetry audit; no ship, promotion, or quality claim

honesty.committed_fixture_checkpoint_block: TwoTowerModel.from_checkpoint raises OutputContractError: checkpoint output contract v0 is incompatible with required symbol_only/v2 (src/slm_training/dsl/language_contract.py require_current_output_contract); no migration path exists
honesty.substitute: scratch twin of the same architecture (d_model 96, 2 context + 3 denoiser layers, gen_steps 8, lexer output, contract v2), 787,586 parameters, AdamW lr 3e-3 for 60 steps on the 13 contract-eligible records of the smoke96 suite; session scratch, not committed
caveats: One 4-CPU CPU-only box shared with other agents; wall times are box-specific.
Suite subsets, not full suites: n=10 smoke, n=10 held_out, n=4 adversarial (the adversarial suite has only 4 records).
The scratch twin is undertrained, which biases the exhaustion measurement toward MORE stalls, not fewer.
Only the positionwise MaskGIT unmask lane is instrumented; the cluster lane and the one-hole exact-bypass admit probe are not.

paper.name: LAVE
paper.mechanism: after tau consecutive proposal failures, replace the context with a cached prefix

n12_statement: asap.penalize + remask_ratio already cover LAVE's recovery; the only measurable gap is stall termination (GenerationExhausted rate), which is about 0 on fixtures.
verdict: N12 conclusion HOLDS; N12 rationale NOT SUPPORTED
findings: GenerationExhausted rate is 0/48 document decodes across both arms and all three suites; the falsifier did not fire.
asap.penalize fired 0 times on every real run: asap_decode defaults to False, so the ASAp ledger is never constructed on the production path.
remask_ratio is 0.0 on the production path, so remasking never ran either.
The admit probe rejected 0 of 2,132 real probes, so neither recovery mechanism had a rejection to recover from.

Every one of those 2,132 probe canvases carried a committed token after the first hole (admit_probe_committed_suffix == admit_probe_canvases), the HX1 left-prefix over-approximation admit_fill cannot validate.
Under a synthetic 100% admit-rejection control the loop reaches a 306-long consecutive rejection run and still terminates with 0 exhaustion: LTR repair absorbs the stall.

14 of 24 MaskGIT documents ended in a certified substitution (certified_fallbacks >= 1) that PlaygroundService recorded as a successful generation: _raise_on_substituted_generation reads consume_generation_evidence, which the torch backend does not expose (only the ONNX backend does).

proposed_lever_not_implemented.status: proposed only; NOT implemented in this change
proposed_lever_not_implemented.description: LAVE tau-analogue: after tau consecutive admit-probe rejections with no commit, restart the MaskGIT sweep from a cached certified prefix instead of continuing to propose into a dead canvas.
proposed_lever_not_implemented.why_not_now: The measured consecutive-rejection run is 0 on every real fixture decode, so the lever has no observable trigger to tune against and would be a parameter added on an unmeasured effect.

preregistration.prereg_gate: Do not implement until a corpus is found where max_consecutive_rejection_run >= 2 on at least 10% of documents with real admit_fill (n >= 96, two seeds).
preregistration.invariants: I1-I6 unchanged; restart must re-verify before commit (I3).

higher_priority_gap.finding: Certified substitution, not exhaustion, is the live failure channel: 14/24 MaskGIT documents and 14/24 serving-default documents were answered with a certified minimal program while the serving harness recorded success, because the torch backend exposes no consume_generation_evidence channel for _raise_on_substituted_generation.
higher_priority_gap.status: reported, not fixed in this change

reproduction.record_selection: first n records of each suite file, in file order
reproduction.decode_seam: PlaygroundService.generate(prompt, grammar_constrained=True, max_attempts=3) with an injected model_factory, wrapped in collect_decode_stats(); the maskgit arm re-points the decode lane AFTER PlaygroundService._load_locked pins the serving policy (grammar_ltr_primary=False, compiler_decode_mode='off', grammar_fastpath_mode in {mask, hybrid}, unmask_mode='positions'), leaving every serving honesty flag (allow_unconstrained_fallback=False, grammar_finalize_validate=False) untouched.
reproduction.scratch_runners: session scratch directory, not committed: train_twin.py, n12_run.py, mkjson.py
